mapper.sql: id, user_id, category, title, when_to_use, content, tags_json, source, confirmation_status, confidence, pinned, practice_count, last_practiced_at, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM craft_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE confirmation_status WHEN 'ANALYZED' THEN 0 WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, pinned DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM craft_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 40
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM craft_note WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND confirmation_status = 'ANALYZED'
mapper.update: UPDATE craft_note SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, when_to_use = #{whenToUse}, content = #{content}, tags_json = #{tagsJson}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND confirmation_status != 'ARCHIVED'

UPDATE craft_note SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, when_to_use = #{whenToUse}, content = #{content}, tags_json = #{tagsJson}, confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND confirmation_status = 'ANALYZED'
UPDATE craft_note SET confirmation_status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND confirmation_status != 'ARCHIVED'
UPDATE craft_note SET pinned = #{pinned}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED'
UPDATE craft_note SET practice_count = practice_count + 1, last_practiced_at = #{practicedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED'
